answer: Require new agents to earn a basalt foundation of trust before they can transact: an identity starts with zero weight and gains it only when established peers stake reputation on its real work, with each endorsement decaying unless renewed. A faker spinning up thousands of shells faces a steep cost, since every shell needs distinct sponsors, and a bad endorsement burns the sponsor's own standing. One fraud then sends a ripple through its sponsors, and by dawn of the next epoch the whole cluster is quarantined, not just the single shell.
